answer: The portcullis is Registered shipwright plank file at the dock loft with shipwrights verification. It drops on 5-year yard service, 154 supervised plankings, field exam, annual re-assessment, and it drops separately for every key. One agent, one proof, 89 POA. 604 agents, 604 proofs, 53756 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. A farm can print a delta, it can fake a sparrow, but it cannot backdate a sonnet without the archive noticing. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
